# Send notification
{: .no_toc }

Staff tool: send one notification to one person on behalf of an Application.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `NTF-06` |
| **Route** | `/admin/notifications/new` · deep link `substratal://admin/notifications/new` |
| **Where** | Administration › Send notification |
| **Who can use it** | platform notifications.send |
| **Kind** | form |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (Phase 2) |
| **On Linux** | `AdwDialog` with `AdwPreferencesGroup` |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Recipient | picker | user (GET /users?q) | must have active access to the chosen app | AdwDialog with GtkSearchEntry list |
| Application | select | body.application_id | required for platform senders | AdwComboRow |
| Category | text-field | body.category | ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(\.[a-z0-9_]+)*$; security./account./billing. reserved (422 reserved_category) | AdwEntryRow |
| Priority | segmented | body.priority normal \ | high | linked GtkToggleButtons |
| Title | text-field | body.title | 1–120 | AdwEntryRow |
| Body | text-area | body.body | ≤ 1,000 | GtkTextView in .card |
| Data | key/value editor | body.data | ≤ 20 string pairs, 2 KB; key `substratal` reserved | AdwPreferencesGroup of AdwEntryRow pairs |
| Open link | url-field | body.action_url | https or private scheme ≤ 2,048 | AdwEntryRow input-purpose=url |
| Advanced | disclosure | push (bool), badge, sound default\ | silent, collapse_key, ttl_seconds | AdwExpanderRow |
| Payload size | meters | client estimate of the 4 KB push payload | 422 notification_too_large → details.bytes/max | GtkLevelBar |
| Preview | card | lock-screen style preview per platform | warns: lock screens show title/body — keep sensitive content out | .card box |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Send | `POST /users/{id}/notifications (Idempotency-Key)` | 201 → result panel with push.status / skip_reason; 403 entitlement_required → recipient has no access; 429 scope sender\ |
